subsets.web-pages: Page bodies, documentation and structured records; category retains the original finer classification
subsets.documents: Complete document text, including embedded documents, tables and appendices
subsets.images: Requested image URLs or delivered image files; image understanding is outside the task
subsets.videos: Declared video resources, playback or download entries, files and metadata
subsets.challenge-pages: Target content or qualifying records on sites with observed access challenges
subsets.dynamic-examples: Public asynchronous, client-rendered, embedded-state and embedded-frame examples
subsets.dynamic-content: Content loaded after the initial response, including asynchronous requests and client-rendered records
subsets.popular-sites: Task-relevant stable content and qualifying named records or links on widely used websites
subsets.access-restrictions: Target content at URLs with previously observed access restrictions
subsets.articles: Article bodies, titles, requested initial comments and post collections

subsets.scenarios-v1: Scenario queries with the first reference edition
subsets.scenarios-v2: The same scenario queries with qualified source-reference rules; not independent samples from v1
subsets.factual-v1: SimpleQA Verified retrieval tasks; the independently versioned derivative supplies the same selected questions

subsets.corrected-545: Frozen HTML with corrected reference Markdown and feature-scope annotations

subsets.factual-v1: Unchanged publisher questions of at most 128 Unicode code points, with reference answers and URLs
